title: init response
description: Standard output of init in JSON mode (INIT-040): the workspace set up, or a refusal. Input errors (INIT-011, INIT-013) go to standard error as plain text.

linux.description: The Linux tree now configured, absolute.

devicetree.description: The base devicetree now configured, absolute.

overlay.description: The overlay workfile now configured, absolute.

created.description: true when init created the workfile (INIT-034), false when it kept the configured one.

indexed.description: true when init built the binding caches (INIT-032), false when they were current.
